corrections.why: Canada Lookouts, Ominous and the geocities tower-history page all spell the name Stetham; only the Firelookout.ca record uses Stretham.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.ca gives the address as Greater Sudbury; Canada Lookouts lists the tower under Gogama and a tower-history page places it north of Gogama. The story gives both and does not choose.

Firelookout.ca says the observer's cabin sits in the centre of the steel structure; the tower-history page says the towerman's cabin is right under the base. The two may describe different cabins, but no source says so. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, staffing record, fire or notable event turned up in the sources read, so the story has none. The record name Stretham is proposed as a correction to Stetham (see corrections); a human should confirm the spelling against an official source, since the LIO record's official name (not quotable from the cached page) reads Stetham. The LIO tower layer (not quotable from the cached page) gives the official name as MNR Stetham Fire Tower and the location as a township; not used as evidence. A forestrangers still-standing list in data/raw/expansion/on marks Stetham with an asterisk; its legend is in a Facebook group post that could not be read, so the asterisk is not used. The Ominous listing calls the site relatively accessible and describes the approach; that is a visitor's remark, not an access status, so no access level is set. Land ownership and whether visitors are allowed are not stated in any source read. The Ominous listing has 15 photos; none were checked for licence, so none are listed.
